addon_apply_busy: A file move is in progress - please wait for it to finish.
aircraft_experimental_notice: ⚠️ Experimental feature - it's new, please double-check the result after enabling/disabling aircraft.
aircraft_grouping_hint: Grouped by developer (derived from the package name), not the "manufacturer" field - add-ons fill that in inconsistently. Liveries reliably matched to a specific aircraft are shown nested under it; the rest stay in the "unassigned" section under the developer.
dialog_community: Select main Community folder for MSFS
dialog_disabled_path: Select the folder for disabled add-ons
disabled_path_cross_drive_warning: The chosen folder is on a different drive than Community. Moving there won't be an instant rename anymore, but an actual data copy - for large packages this can take minutes and the app will be unresponsive during that time.
disabled_path_hint: Empty = default location next to Community. Can also be set to a different drive.
disabled_path_invalid_nested: This folder can't be used - it's the same as Community or contained within it (or the other way around).
err_delay: Error: Delay must be a positive number!
err_empty: Error: Name and path must be filled!
exe_not_found: The exe.xml file was not found at this path!
exe_xml_path_hint: Where the app reads/writes the AutoStart addon list (exe.xml). Automatically derived from the MSFS version/platform above - only change this if the app can't find the file on its own.
exe_rename_hint: 💡 Tip: Rename an add-on by clicking ✏️. Leave the field blank to reset to the original name.
exe_restore_confirm_message: This overwrites the current exe.xml with the backup the app made before its very first edit of this file. This can't be undone.
gsx_legend_match: profile from the scenery's own developer
gsx_legend_missing: no profile - click to search flightsim.to
gsx_path_hint: Where the app checks whether you have a GSX (virtuali) profile installed for a given scenery. Defaults to GSX's standard install location - only change this if you moved it elsewhere.
launch_missing_message: These selected apps won't launch - their file path no longer exists: {}. Continue anyway?
onboarding_intro: Before you start, set your Community folder path - without it the app can't manage sceneries or aircraft.
onboarding_optional_hint: The GSX path and SimBrief username are optional - you can fill them in later in Settings too.
post_launch_watch: Stay and watch for sim exit
scenery_apply_pending_hint: 💡 Tip: Checking an item only queues the change - nothing moves until you click Apply.
scenery_conflict_hint: ⚠️ Enabled sceneries at the same airport - they can fight over tiles and cause visual glitches in the sim. Consider disabling one of them:
scenery_gsx_match_tt: GSX profile found - looks like it's from the same developer as the scenery
scenery_gsx_missing_tt: No GSX profile found - click to search flightsim.to
scenery_gsx_unmatched_tt: GSX profile found, but can't confirm it's from the same developer as the scenery
scenery_map_hint: Showing {} of {} sceneries on the map (the rest have no recognizable ICAO code).
scenery_no_community: First set the Community folder path in Settings.
set_nav_hint: Used for the Navigraph AIRAC check and the Scenery tab.
simbrief_no_username: Set your SimBrief username in Settings first.
simbrief_username_hint: Used to fetch your last planned flight and compare it against installed sceneries (Scenery tab).
tray_tooltip: FlightOps Hub – waiting for flight to load...
